Aisberg Telegram News UA
	

A continuously updated, de-identified corpus of Ukrainian Telegram news and the discussion around it, published by the Ukrainian non-profit Aisberg (ГО «АЙЗБЕРГ»). It comes in two layers. The first is the raw monthly stream: every post from a fixed set of public news channels, with its reactions and its comment thread. The second is the analysis behind every report Aisberg publishes: posts from different channels grouped into one event, the manipulation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/aisbergpublicorganization/telegram-news-ua-dataset.
